sections.title: Unit 14 - Direct / Reported Speech; Say - Tell; Changes
sections.titleUz: 14-unit - To'g'ridan-to'g'ri / ko'chirma gap; Say - Tell; O'zgarishlar

exercises.instructionEn: Direct speech is exactly what someone says. Reported speech is the exact meaning of what someone said but not the exact words. Say - Tell. Changes in reported speech.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri gap - kimdir aytgan aniq so'zlar. Ko'chirma gap - kimdir aytganining aniq ma'nosi, lekin aniq so'zlari emas. Say - Tell. Ko'chirma gapdagi o'zgarishlar.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA GAP (14-unit).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI va KO'ChIRMA ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI = aniq so'zlar
  (qo'shtirnoqda):
  "I'll go to York," Jim said.
  KO'ChIRMA = ma'nosi, so'zlar
  o'zgargan:
  Jim said (that) he WOULD go to
  York.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SAY yoki TELL                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SAY - olmoshsiz yoki 'TO' bilan:
    "I can't help you," Tim SAID TO
    ME.
    He SAID that he would be on
    time.
  TELL - har doim OLMOSh bilan,
  'to' YO'Q:
    He TOLD ME that Sue had left.
    "Sue has left," he TOLD ME.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ZAMON O'ZGARIShI                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Reporting verb HOZIRGI zamonda
  (says) → zamon O'ZGARMAYDI:
    "He is wrong," she SAYS. →
    She says he IS wrong.

  Reporting verb O'TGAN zamonda
  (said) → zamon O'ZGARADI:
    "He is wrong," she SAID. →
    She said he WAS wrong.

  ⚠ To'liq jadval 100-betda.


⚠ 'EXACTLY':

  = aynan.


⚠ 'ON TIME':

  = o'z vaqtida.

tasks.en: Direct speech is exactly what someone says. Reported speech is the exact meaning of what someone said but not the exact words. Say - Tell. Changes in reported speech.
tasks.uz: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri gap - kimdir aytgan aniq so'zlar. Ko'chirma gap - kimdir aytganining aniq ma'nosi, lekin aniq so'zlari emas. Say - Tell. Ko'chirma gapdagi o'zgarishlar.

tasks.en: Direct speech is exactly what someone says. "I'll go to York," Jim said. Reported speech is the exact meaning of what someone said but not the exact words. Jim said (that) he would go to York.
tasks.uz: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri gap - kimdir aytgan aniq so'zlar. "Yorkka boraman", - dedi Jim. Ko'chirma gap - kimdir aytganining aniq ma'nosi, lekin aniq so'zlari emas. Jim Yorkka borishini aytdi.

tasks.en: We use say with or without a personal pronoun. We use to after say when there is a personal pronoun. "I can't help you," Tim said to me. He said that he would be on time.
tasks.uz: 'Say' ni olmosh bilan yoki olmoshsiz ishlatamiz. Olmosh bo'lsa 'say' dan keyin 'to' ishlatamiz. "Senga yordam bera olmayman", - dedi Tim menga. U o'z vaqtida bo'lishini aytdi.

tasks.en: We use tell with a personal object pronoun. We never use to after tell. He told me that Sue had left. "Sue has left," he told me.
tasks.uz: 'Tell' ni to'ldiruvchi olmosh bilan ishlatamiz. 'Tell' dan keyin hech qachon 'to' ishlatmaymiz. U menga Sue ketganini aytdi. "Sue ketdi", - dedi u menga.

tasks.en: When the reporting verb (say, tell etc) is in the present simple tense, the verb tenses do not change in reported speech. "He is wrong," she says. → She says he is wrong.
tasks.uz: Ko'chiruvchi fe'l (say, tell) hozirgi oddiy zamonda bo'lsa, ko'chirma gapda zamonlar o'zgarmaydi. "U noto'g'ri", - deydi u. → U uning noto'g'riligini aytadi.

tasks.en: When the reporting verb is in the past tense, the verb tenses change in reported speech. "He is wrong," she said. → She said he was wrong.
tasks.uz: Ko'chiruvchi fe'l o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa, ko'chirma gapda zamonlar o'zgaradi. "U noto'g'ri", - dedi u. → U uning noto'g'riligini aytdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Tenses change as follows: Present Simple → Past Simple; Present Continuous → Past Continuous; Past Simple → Past Perfect; Past Continuous → Past Perfect Continuous; Present Perfect → Past Perfect; Will → Would; Can → Could. Personal pronouns and possessive adjectives change according to context.
exercises.instructionUz: Zamonlar shunday o'zgaradi: Present Simple → Past Simple; Present Continuous → Past Continuous; Past Simple → Past Perfect; Past Continuous → Past Perfect Continuous; Present Perfect → Past Perfect; Will → Would; Can → Could. Kishilik olmoshlari va egalik sifatlari kontekstga qarab o'zgaradi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA GAPDA ZAMON O'ZGARIShI
(reporting verb o'tgan zamonda):

  PRESENT SIMPLE → PAST SIMPLE
    "I LIKE it." → He said he
    LIKED it.
  PRESENT CONT. → PAST CONT.
    "I'M GOING out." → He said he
    WAS GOING out.
  PAST SIMPLE → PAST PERFECT
    "We MET in 1998." → He said
    they HAD MET in 1998.
  PAST CONT. → PAST PERFECT CONT.
    "Tom WAS EATING pizza." → He
    said Tom HAD BEEN EATING pizza.
  PRESENT PERFECT → PAST PERFECT
    "I'VE KNOWN her." → He said he
    HAD KNOWN her.
  WILL → WOULD
    "I'LL tell her." → He said he
    WOULD tell her.
  CAN → COULD
    "I CAN do it." → He said he
    COULD do it.

  ⚠ Qoida: BIR QADAM ORQAGA.


OLMOShLAR O'ZGARADI:

  "I saw YOU," she said to George.
  → She said to George that SHE
    had seen HIM.
  I → she; you → him.


⚠ 'ACCORDING TO CONTEXT':

  = kontekstga qarab.


⚠ 'POSSESSIVE ADJECTIVES':

  = egalik sifatlari (my, your,
  his ...).

tasks.en: Tenses change as follows: Present Simple → Past Simple; Present Continuous → Past Continuous; Past Simple → Past Perfect; Past Continuous → Past Perfect Continuous; Present Perfect → Past Perfect; Will → Would; Can → Could. Personal pronouns and possessive adjectives change according to context.
tasks.uz: Zamonlar shunday o'zgaradi: Present Simple → Past Simple; Present Continuous → Past Continuous; Past Simple → Past Perfect; Past Continuous → Past Perfect Continuous; Present Perfect → Past Perfect; Will → Would; Can → Could. Kishilik olmoshlari va egalik sifatlari kontekstga qarab o'zgaradi.

tasks.en: Present Simple → Past Simple. "I like it," he said. → He said he liked it. Present Continuous → Past Continuous. "I'm going out," he said. → He said he was going out.
tasks.uz: Present Simple → Past Simple. "Menga yoqadi", - dedi u. → U yoqishini aytdi. Present Continuous → Past Continuous. "Chiqyapman", - dedi u. → U chiqayotganini aytdi.
tasks.note: ⚠ like → liked; am going → was going.

tasks.en: Past Simple → Past Perfect. "We met in 1998," he said. → He said they had met in 1998. Past Continuous → Past Perfect Continuous. "Tom was eating pizza," he said. → He said Tom had been eating pizza.
tasks.uz: Past Simple → Past Perfect. "1998 yilda uchrashdik", - dedi u. → U 1998 yilda uchrashganlarini aytdi. Past Continuous → Past Perfect Continuous. "Tom pitsa yeyayotgan edi", - dedi u. → U Tom pitsa yeyayotganini aytdi.
tasks.note: ⚠ met → had met; was eating → had been eating.

tasks.en: Present Perfect → Past Perfect. "I've known her," he said. → He said he had known her. Will → Would. "I'll tell her," he said. → He said he would tell her. Can → Could. "I can do it," he said. → He said he could do it.
tasks.uz: Present Perfect → Past Perfect. "Uni bilaman", - dedi u. → U uni bilishini aytdi. Will → Would. "Unga aytaman", - dedi u. → U unga aytishini aytdi. Can → Could. "Qila olaman", - dedi u. → U qila olishini aytdi.
tasks.note: ⚠ have known → had known; will → would; can → could.

tasks.en: Personal pronouns and possessive adjectives change according to context. "I saw you," she said to George. → She said to George that she had seen him.
tasks.uz: Kishilik olmoshlari va egalik sifatlari kontekstga qarab o'zgaradi. "Seni ko'rdim", - dedi u Georgega. → U Georgega uni ko'rganini aytdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Reported questions are introduced with ask, want to know etc. We use affirmative word order and the question mark becomes a full stop. Inverted commas are omitted. ask + question word: "What's his name?" She asked. → She asked what his name was. ask + if/whether: "Can you help me?" she asked. → She asked if I could help her.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'chirma savollar ask, want to know va h.k. bilan kiritiladi. Darak gap tartibini ishlatamiz, so'roq belgisi nuqtaga aylanadi. Qo'shtirnoq tushiriladi. ask + so'roq so'zi: "Uning ismi nima?" - so'radi u. → U uning ismi nima ekanini so'radi. ask + if/whether: "Menga yordam bera olasizmi?" - so'radi u. → U unga yordam bera olishimni so'radi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA SAVOLLAR:

  Kiritiladi: ask, want to know,
  wonder ...
  ⚠ DARAK GAP TARTIBI (ega +
  fe'l).
  ⚠ So'roq belgisi (?) → nuqta (.).
  ⚠ Qo'shtirnoq YO'Q.

  1 SO'ROQ SO'ZLI savol → ask +
    so'roq so'zi:
    "What's his name?" →
    She asked WHAT HIS NAME WAS.
    ('what was his name' EMAS!)

  2 HA/YO'Q savol (yordamchi fe'l
    bilan boshlanadi) → ask +
    IF/WHETHER:
    "Can you help me?" →
    She asked IF I COULD help her.


⚠ 'INVERTED COMMAS':

  = qo'shtirnoq (" ").


⚠ 'TO OMIT':

  = tushirib qoldirmoq.


⚠ 'A FULL STOP':

  = nuqta.


⚠ 'WHETHER':

  = ...mi yoki yo'qmi (= if).

tasks.en: Reported questions are introduced with ask, want to know etc. We use affirmative word order and the question mark becomes a full stop. Inverted commas are omitted. ask + question word: "What's his name?" She asked. → She asked what his name was. ask + if/whether: "Can you help me?" she asked. → She asked if I could help her.
tasks.uz: Ko'chirma savollar ask, want to know va h.k. bilan kiritiladi. Darak gap tartibini ishlatamiz, so'roq belgisi nuqtaga aylanadi. Qo'shtirnoq tushiriladi. ask + so'roq so'zi: "Uning ismi nima?" - so'radi u. → U uning ismi nima ekanini so'radi. ask + if/whether: "Menga yordam bera olasizmi?" - so'radi u. → U unga yordam bera olishimni so'radi.

tasks.en: Reported questions are introduced with ask, want to know etc. We use affirmative word order and the question mark becomes a full stop. Inverted commas are omitted.
tasks.uz: Ko'chirma savollar ask, want to know va h.k. bilan kiritiladi. Darak gap tartibini ishlatamiz, so'roq belgisi nuqtaga aylanadi. Qo'shtirnoq tushiriladi.

tasks.en: ask + question word (who, where, when etc) when the direct question begins with a question word. "What's his name?" She asked. → She asked what his name was.
tasks.uz: ask + so'roq so'zi (who, where, when) - to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol so'roq so'zi bilan boshlansa. "Uning ismi nima?" - so'radi u. → U uning ismi nima ekanini so'radi.

tasks.en: ask + if/whether when the direct question begins with an auxiliary verb. "Can you help me?" she asked. → She asked if I could help her.
tasks.uz: ask + if/whether - to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol yordamchi fe'l bilan boshlansa. "Menga yordam bera olasizmi?" - so'radi u. → U unga yordam bera olishimni so'radi.

sections.titleUz: 15-unit - Ko'chirma buyruqlar; Undov gaplar; Savol-quyruqlar; Intonatsiya; Artikllar

exercises.instructionEn: Reported orders/instructions: ask, order etc + to-infinitive. "Go out!" → He ordered me to go out. "Don't go!" → He asked me not to go. Exclamations: how + adjective/adverb; what + a/an (+adjective) + singular countable noun; what (+adjective) + uncountable/plural nouns.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'chirma buyruq/ko'rsatmalar: ask, order va h.k. + to-infinitiv. "Chiq!" → U menga chiqishni buyurdi. "Ketma!" → U mendan ketmaslikni so'radi. Undov gaplar: how + sifat/ravish; what + a/an (+sifat) + birlik sanaladigan ot; what (+sifat) + sanalmaydigan/ko'plik otlar.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQLAR:

  ask / order / tell + KIM + (NOT)
  TO + FE'L
  "Go out!" → He ORDERED me TO GO
    out.
  "Don't go!" → He ASKED me NOT TO
    GO.


UNDOV GAPLAR:

  Hayrat, ajablanish bildiradi.
  Oxirida undov belgisi (!).

  1 HOW + SIFAT/RAVISh:
    'How nice!'
    'How carefully she drives!'
  2 WHAT + A/AN (+SIFAT) + BIRLIK
    SANALADIGAN OT:
    'What a nice day!'
    'What an exciting trip!'
  3 WHAT (+SIFAT) + SANALMAYDIGAN/
    KO'PLIK OT (a/an YO'Q):
    'What colourful pictures!'
    'What awful weather!'


⚠ 'TO ORDER':

  = buyurmoq.


⚠ 'ADMIRATION':

  = hayrat, qoyil qolish.


⚠ 'AN EXCLAMATION MARK':

  = undov belgisi (!).

tasks.en: Reported orders/instructions: ask, order etc + to-infinitive. "Go out!" → He ordered me to go out. "Don't go!" → He asked me not to go. Exclamations: how + adjective/adverb; what + a/an (+adjective) + singular countable noun; what (+adjective) + uncountable/plural nouns.
tasks.uz: Ko'chirma buyruq/ko'rsatmalar: ask, order va h.k. + to-infinitiv. "Chiq!" → U menga chiqishni buyurdi. "Ketma!" → U mendan ketmaslikni so'radi. Undov gaplar: how + sifat/ravish; what + a/an (+sifat) + birlik sanaladigan ot; what (+sifat) + sanalmaydigan/ko'plik otlar.

tasks.en: To report orders or instructions we use ask, order etc followed by a to-infinitive. "Go out!" he said to me. → He ordered me to go out. "Don't go!" he said to me. → He asked me not to go.
tasks.uz: Buyruq yoki ko'rsatmalarni ko'chirish uchun ask, order va h.k. + to-infinitiv ishlatamiz. "Chiq!" - dedi u menga. → U menga chiqishni buyurdi. "Ketma!" - dedi u menga. → U mendan ketmaslikni so'radi.

tasks.en: Exclamations are words or sentences used to express admiration, surprise etc. To form exclamatory sentences we can use how, what (a/an) etc. Exclamatory sentences take an exclamation mark (!) at the end.
tasks.uz: Undov gaplar - hayrat, ajablanish va h.k. bildiruvchi so'z yoki gaplar. Undov gaplarni how, what (a/an) va h.k. bilan yasaymiz. Undov gaplar oxirida undov belgisi (!) bo'ladi.

tasks.en: We use how + adjective/adverb. How nice! How carefully she drives! We use what + a/an (+adjective) + singular countable noun. What a nice day! What an exciting trip! We use what (+adjective) + uncountable/plural nouns. What colourful pictures! What awful weather!
tasks.uz: How + sifat/ravish ishlatamiz. Qanday yaxshi! U qanday ehtiyotkor haydaydi! What + a/an (+sifat) + birlik sanaladigan ot ishlatamiz. Qanday yaxshi kun! Qanday hayajonli sayohat! What (+sifat) + sanalmaydigan/ko'plik otlar ishlatamiz. Qanday rangli suratlar! Qanday dahshatli ob-havo!

exercises.instructionEn: Question tags are short questions at the end of statements, formed with the auxiliary verb from the main sentence and the appropriate subject pronoun. He is tall, isn't he? Present simple: do/does. He lives in Manchester, doesn't he? Past simple: did. He left, didn't he? Positive statement → negative tag; negative statement → positive tag. Intonation: sure → voice goes down (↘); not sure → voice goes up (↗).
exercises.instructionUz: Savol-quyruqlar - gap oxiridagi qisqa savollar, asosiy gapdagi yordamchi fe'l va mos ega olmoshi bilan yasaladi. U baland bo'yli, shundaymi? Hozirgi oddiy: do/does. U Manchesterda yashaydi, shundaymi? O'tgan oddiy: did. U ketdi, shundaymi? Ijobiy gap → inkor quyruq; inkor gap → ijobiy quyruq. Intonatsiya: ishonch → ovoz pasayadi (↘); ishonchsiz → ovoz ko'tariladi (↗).
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL-QUYRUQLAR (QUESTION TAGS):

  Gap OXIRIDA qisqa savol.
  Yordamchi fe'l + OLMOSh.

  'be' bilan: 'He IS tall, ISN'T
    HE?'
  PRESENT SIMPLE → do/does:
    'He LIVES in Manchester,
     DOESN'T HE?'
  PAST SIMPLE → did:
    'He LEFT, DIDN'T HE?'

  IJOBIY gap → INKOR quyruq:
    'He IS from Spain, ISN'T he?'
  INKOR gap → IJOBIY quyruq:
    'He ISN'T from France, IS he?'


INTONATSIYa:

  ↘ PASAYADI - ishonchim komil,
    tasdiq kutaman:
    'She works at a bank, doesn't
     she?' ↘ (bilaman)
  ↗ KO'TARILADI - ishonchim yo'q,
    haqiqiy savol:
    "She's got a sister, hasn't
     she?" ↗ (bilmayman)


⚠ 'APPROPRIATE':

  = mos.


⚠ 'Manchester':

  = Manchester (Angliya shahri).

Present simple: do/does. He lives in Manchester, doesn't he? Past simple: did. He left, didn't he? Positive statement → negative tag; negative statement → positive tag. Intonation: sure → voice goes down (↘); not sure → voice goes up (↗).
tasks.uz: Savol-quyruqlar - gap oxiridagi qisqa savollar, asosiy gapdagi yordamchi fe'l va mos ega olmoshi bilan yasaladi. U baland bo'yli, shundaymi? Hozirgi oddiy: do/does. U Manchesterda yashaydi, shundaymi? O'tgan oddiy: did. U ketdi, shundaymi? Ijobiy gap → inkor quyruq; inkor gap → ijobiy quyruq. Intonatsiya: ishonch → ovoz pasayadi (↘); ishonchsiz → ovoz ko'tariladi (↗).

tasks.en: Question tags are short questions at the end of statements. We form them with the auxiliary verb from the main sentence and the appropriate subject pronoun. He is tall, isn't he?
tasks.uz: Savol-quyruqlar - gap oxiridagi qisqa savollar. Ularni asosiy gapdagi yordamchi fe'l va mos ega olmoshi bilan yasaymiz. U baland bo'yli, shundaymi?

tasks.en: When the verb of the sentence is in the present simple, we use do/does in the question tag. He lives in Manchester, doesn't he? When the verb of the sentence is in the past simple, we use did in the question tag. He left, didn't he?
tasks.uz: Gap fe'li hozirgi oddiy zamonda bo'lsa, savol-quyruqda do/does ishlatamiz. U Manchesterda yashaydi, shundaymi? Gap fe'li o'tgan oddiy zamonda bo'lsa, savol-quyruqda did ishlatamiz. U ketdi, shundaymi?
tasks.note: ⚠ lives → doesn't he; left → didn't he.

tasks.en: A positive statement takes a negative question tag. He is from Spain, isn't he? A negative statement takes a positive question tag. He isn't from France, is he?
tasks.uz: Ijobiy gap inkor savol-quyruq oladi. U Ispaniyadan, shundaymi? Inkor gap ijobiy savol-quyruq oladi. U Fransiyadan emas, shundaymi?

tasks.en: When we are sure of the answer, the voice goes down in the question tag (↘). She works at a bank, doesn't she? (sure) When we are not sure of the answer, the voice goes up in the question tag (↗). She's got a sister, hasn't she?
tasks.uz: Javobga ishonchimiz komil bo'lsa, savol-quyruqda ovoz pasayadi (↘). U bankda ishlaydi, shundaymi? (ishonch) Javobga ishonchimiz komil bo'lmasa, savol-quyruqda ovoz ko'tariladi (↗). Uning singlisi bor, shundaymi?

exercises.instructionEn: A/An - The. We use a/an to talk about something for the first time. We use the to talk about something we have mentioned before. There's a car outside. The car belongs to Mr Jones. We also use the before names of rivers, seas, oceans, mountain ranges, nationalities, names of families. exercises.explanationUz:
ARTIKLLAR: A/AN - THE.

  A/AN - BIRINChI MARTA:
    "There's A car outside."
  THE - OLDIN TILGA OLINGAN:
    'THE car belongs to Mr Jones.'


'THE' IShLATILADI:

  • daryolar: the Amazon River
  • dengizlar: the Black Sea
  • okeanlar: the Pacific
  • tog' tizmalari: the Alps
  • millatlar: the English
  • oila nomlari: the Browns


'THE' IShLATILMAYDI:

  • atoqli otlar: Jane, Rome
  • mamlakatlar: Britain
  • ovqatlar: lunch
  • sport/o'yinlar: tennis

  ⚠ Istisnolar: the USA, the UK
  (ko'plik/qo'shma nomlar).


⚠ 'TO BELONG TO':

  = ...ga tegishli bo'lmoq.


⚠ 'A MOUNTAIN RANGE':

  = tog' tizmasi.


⚠ 'A PROPER NAME':

  = atoqli ot.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I get up at seven every day. She gets up at eight.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men har kuni yettida turaman. U sakkizda turadi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I don't play tennis. He doesn't play football.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men tennis o'ynamayman. U futbol o'ynamaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Does he like tennis? - Yes, he does.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U tennisni yoqtiradimi? - Ha.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm playing tennis now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men hozir tennis o'ynayapman.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + RAVISh + FE'L. / EGA + be + RAVISh.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I never get up early. He is always late.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men hech qachon erta turmayman. U har doim kech qoladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + FE'L-ED / didn't + FE'L. Did + EGA + FE'L?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I worked yesterday. I didn't see Tom. Did you call me?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha ishladim. Tomni ko'rmadim. Menga qo'ng'iroq qildingmi?

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I used to work as a cleaner.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men farrosh bo'lib ishlardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: a/an + FIKR + O'LChAM + RANG + MATERIAL + OT
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's an expensive, short, black, leather jacket.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu qimmat, kalta, qora, teri kurtka.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is + SIFAT-ER / more + SIFAT + than Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This car is cheaper than that one. It's more expensive than mine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu mashina anavidan arzonroq. U menikidan qimmatroq.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is the + SIFAT-EST / most + SIFAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's the biggest house in the street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu ko'chadagi eng katta uy.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is as + SIFAT + as Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My brother is as tall as my father.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Akam otam bilan bir xil bo'yda.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is much + SIFAT-ER than Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: An elephant is much heavier than a mouse.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Fil sichqondan ancha og'irroq.

sentencePatterns.formula: X was + -ING when Y + PAST SIMPLE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She was having a bath when the phone rang.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U cho'milayotganda telefon jiringladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: John was cutting the grass while Jenny was planting flowers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: John o't o'rayotganda Jenny gul ekayotgan edi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think there will be rain tomorrow.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, ertaga yomg'ir bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The phone is ringing. - I'll answer it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Telefon jiringlayapti. - Men javob beraman.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I am going to join a gym next week.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kelasi hafta sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman.

sentencePatterns.formula: Look at X! It's going to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Look at the dark clouds! It's going to rain.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qora bulutlarga qara! Yomg'ir yog'adi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I study hard, I'll do well in the test.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar qattiq o'qisam, testda yaxshi natija ko'rsataman.

sentencePatterns.formula: Would you like some ...? / Can I have some ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Would you like some cake? Can I have some water, please?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tort xohlaysizmi? Biroz suv olsam bo'ladimi?

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should take regular exercise. You shouldn't throw rubbish in the street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Muntazam mashq qilishingiz kerak. Ko'chaga axlat tashlamasligingiz kerak.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've worked. He hasn't worked. Have they worked?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men ishladim. U ishlamadi. Ular ishladimi?

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you ever been to Paris?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Parijga borganmisiz?

sentencePatterns.formula: I've already + V3. / I haven't + V3 + yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've already done it. I haven't done the ironing yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Allaqachon qildim. Dazmolni hali qilmadim.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've just finished my homework.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hozirgina uy vazifamni tugatdim.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've worked here for seven years. I've worked here since 1992.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yerda yetti yildan beri ishlayman. Bu yerda 1992 yildan beri ishlayman.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He has been watching TV for an hour.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U bir soatdan beri televizor ko'rmoqda.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm tired because I've been studying for my exam.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Charchadim, chunki imtihonga tayyorlanayotgan edim.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + PAST SIMPLE + after + EGA + had + V3.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He watched TV after he had finished his homework.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U uy vazifasini tugatgandan keyin televizor ko'rdi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you been working here long?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yerda uzoqdan beri ishlayapsizmi?

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + is/was/has been/will be + V3 (+ by ...).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The house is cleaned. The telephone was invented by Bell.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uy tozalanadi. Telefon Bell tomonidan ixtiro qilingan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Was the car made in Japan?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mashina Yaponiyada yasalganmi?

sentencePatterns.formula: X was + -ING when Y + PAST. / X had + V3 when Y + PAST.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He was walking when it started raining. He had entered his house when it started raining.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U yurayotganda yomg'ir boshlandi. Yomg'ir boshlanganda u uyiga kirib bo'lgan edi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Put a gate at the top of your stairs. Don't let your children near the stove.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Zinangiz yuqorisiga panjara qo'ying. Bolalaringizni pech yoniga qo'ymang.

sentencePatterns.formula: You have to / don't have to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You have to buy a ticket. You don't have to help me.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Chipta sotib olishing kerak. Menga yordam berishing shart emas.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You mustn't drink and drive.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ichib mashina haydash mumkin emas.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Am I allowed to keep a pet in my room?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xonamda uy hayvoni saqlashga ruxsat bormi?

sentencePatterns.formula: If I were you, I would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I were you, I would stop smoking.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, chekishni tashlardim.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If anyone calls, tell them I'm not home.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar kimdir qo'ng'iroq qilsa, uyda emasligimni ayt.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He rarely goes anywhere.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U kamdan-kam biror joyga boradi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He let me use his pen.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U menga ruchkasini ishlatishga ruxsat berdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X said to me / X told me (that) + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tim said to me that he couldn't help. He told me that Sue had left.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tim menga yordam bera olmasligini aytdi. U menga Sue ketganini aytdi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She asked what his name was.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U uning ismi nima ekanini so'radi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He ordered me to go out. He asked me not to go.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U menga chiqishni buyurdi. U mendan ketmaslikni so'radi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What colourful pictures! What awful weather!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qanday rangli suratlar! Qanday dahshatli ob-havo!

sentencePatterns.formula: There's a X. The X + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There's a car outside. The car belongs to Mr Jones.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tashqarida mashina bor. Mashina janob Jonesniki.
